content:
maria: Quick heads-up — we plan to enable the per-customer flag "advanced-routing" for Acme Corp tomorrow at 10:00 PDT. This will be a 5% canary on their org with automatic rollback on errors.

maria: Need a short ops checklist and confirmation of fallback behavior. Main asks: allowlist enforcement, contract gating (ensure feature only for contracted seats), VIP bypass rules, and a kill-switch that can be hit without code deploy.

sam: I can own the rollback/monitoring side. Will attach SLO dashboards and an alert rule. Do we have a tracing span to watch for regressions in routing latency?

jin: Product note — Acme is on an add-on contract, not the default plan. Confirming we should gate by org entitlement + per-seat flag. If entitlement absent, response should be 403-like and fall back to legacy routing.

alex: Infra: recommend we use tenant-scoped config + per-tenant KV for allowlist. Quick example:

alex: ```
{
  "flag": "advanced-routing",
  "tenants": ["acme-corp:org-123"],
  "canary_percent": 5,
  "entitlement_required": true,
  "vip_override": ["vip-user-id-1"]
}
```

maria: Perfect — also need kill-switch path exposed in the ops console and a CLI shortcut. Can we add a simple API: `POST /flags/{flag}/tenants/{tenant}/override?state=off` with auth limited to ops role?

alex: Yes. I'll add a one-line endpoint and wire it to the existing feature-toggle service. Deploy-bot will create a short-lived runbook entry too.

deploy-bot: new-runbook: tenant-flag-kill-switch created at https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tenant-flag-kill-switch (ops-only).

sam: For monitoring: I'll create two alerts — one for error rate >0.5% on routing calls for Acme, another for tail latency > 300ms P99. Also adding a pager schedule for on-call during the canary window.

jin: UX: fallback messaging — ensure the client gets the same contract-aware error shape. If legacy routing is used, log a metric `routing.fallback=1` with tenant tag so we can measure.

maria: Security: ensure KMS key access for tenant config and audit logs enabled. Alex, can you confirm HSM/KMS mapping for Acme tenant?

alex: Confirmed — Acme uses the default tenant KMS key in prod. Audit logs will include flag toggles and the actor.

sam: One more ops safety net: add an automatic rollback if routing.fallback metric > 10% for 2 consecutive mins. That matches our usual canary policy.

maria: Sounds good. Quick PR checklist:
- Add tenant allowlist entry for acme-corp
- Add entitlement check in the flag eval
- Add VIP override list (empty for now)
- Expose kill-switch endpoint + docs
- Create runbook and dashboard links in PR

jin: I'll update the contract gating spec and attach example payloads in the PR description.

alex: I'll open infra PR to add the KV entry and endpoint wiring. Targeting small rollout change — no infra migration.

sam: I'll add alerts and schedule rotation for the canary window (10:00–12:00 PDT).

maria: If everyone is good, I'll kick-off the feature flag deploy tomorrow morning. Please drop a :thumbsup: when done with your items.

jin: 👍 will update spec now.

alex: 👍 infra PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/4567

sam: 👍 alerts + on-call schedule set.

deploy-bot: deploy-checklist: all items present, proceeding to canary window once PRs merge.

maria: Thanks — I'll post a short follow-up after the 5% canary completes. If anyone spots anything risky, ping me directly.

jin: Noted — leaving phone on during the window.

maria: End of thread.
